items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. All versions up to and including 3.16.0 are affected, with a fix in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) to address this flaw.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Unauthorized Write Access
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to Adobe Commerce, affecting multiple versions. The flaw can be exploited without user interaction over the network.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability can enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation. It was addressed in the APSB26-92 security update.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability Requiring Admin Privileges
items.summary: This stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires both authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE and Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Dubbed 'SessionReaper' by Sansec, this critical flaw allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks exploiting this vulnerability have been observed globally.

items.title: CosmicSting: Critical File Reading and Potential RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug allowing attackers to read any files, including passwords and secret crypt keys. When combined with CVE-2024-2961, it can lead to remote code execution on affected servers.
